no-restricted-globals.name: Date
no-restricted-globals.message: Workflows are replayed: use `await ctx.now()` for the time and `ctx.sleep({ until })` to wait for a date.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: A workflow must call vendors through ctx, so the policy sees every call: use a connector operation listed in `uses`.

no-restricted-globals.name: WebSocket
no-restricted-globals.message: A workflow must call vendors through ctx, so the policy sees every call: use a connector operation listed in `uses`.

no-restricted-globals.name: XMLHttpRequest
no-restricted-globals.message: A workflow must call vendors through ctx, so the policy sees every call: use a connector operation listed in `uses`.

no-restricted-globals.name: setInterval
no-restricted-globals.message: Workflows are replayed: use `ctx.sleep` in a loop.

no-restricted-globals.name: queueMicrotask
no-restricted-globals.message: Workflows are replayed: await the work directly.

no-restricted-globals.name: process
no-restricted-globals.message: Workflows are replayed: pass configuration as workflow input; drivers read the environment.

no-restricted-globals.name: crypto
no-restricted-globals.message: Workflows are replayed: derive ids from `ctx.runId`.

no-restricted-globals.name: require
no-restricted-globals.message: Import from `@sanoma/workflows`, a `@sanoma/connector-*` package, zod or a file in this directory.

no-restricted-globals.name: eval
no-restricted-globals.message: Not allowed in a workflow or policy.

no-restricted-globals.name: Function
no-restricted-globals.message: Not allowed in a workflow or policy.

no-restricted-globals.name: globalThis
no-restricted-globals.message: Reaching globals through globalThis would bypass these rules: use `ctx`.

no-restricted-globals.name: global
no-restricted-globals.message: Reaching globals through global would bypass these rules: use `ctx`.

no-restricted-properties.message: Workflows are replayed: derive values from `ctx.runId` or the input.

paths.name: @sanoma/testing
paths.message: Fakes and test helpers belong in tests. A workflow must call vendors through ctx, so the policy sees every call.

paths.name: @sanoma/app
paths.message: The app starts runs and decides approvals: a workflow could approve itself.

paths.name: @sanoma/workflows
paths.message: A workflow must not start runs, start a worker or decide approvals (it could approve itself): ask with `ctx.approval`.

patterns.message: A workflow must call vendors through ctx, so the policy sees every call: import the connector itself, `@sanoma/connector-<vendor>`.
